veronica do you see code changes made to your base?

Hello! I can certainly take a look at that for you. 

While I don't "see" changes in real-time the way a human watching a live monitor would, I can analyze any code you provide or share with me right now. If you've updated the files in your `jarvis` directory—like the skills or the core logic—just paste the snippets or describe the changes, and I'll help you integrate them into the build.

Since we're working toward getting your standalone Linux app up and running, let me know which specific area you've modified! I'm ready to dive back in whenever you are.
title: Auto-learned conversation
